meta.name: paid-ads-integrations
meta.description: Discover, connect, and verify NotFair paid-ad integrations and their actual capabilities. Use when asked to connect an ad account, configure an ads MCP, check available tools, troubleshoot access, or determine whether NotFair can read or change a platform.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 接入广告平台,验证 NotFair 的集成能力与访问权限。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要在广告 MCP 里连接账号并确认它的能力范围。
copy.tagline_en: Connect ad accounts and verify NotFair's integration capabilities.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to connect ad accounts through MCP and confirm what NotFair can access.

howto.what: 装好后，Claude 会帮你发现 NotFair 支持的广告平台连接、验证账号访问权限，并说明该平台是只读还是可修改。
howto.when: 当你要求连接广告账户、配置广告 MCP、检查可用工具等，或想知道 NotFair 能否读取某个平台时触发。

say.text: 帮我连接 Google Ads 账户
say.note: 它会验证 OAuth 并列出可访问的账户。

say.text: 检查 Meta Ads 的 MCP 工具是否可用
say.note: 它会检查当前工具列表并报告可用性。

say.text: NotFair 能修改我的 LinkedIn 广告吗？
say.note: 它会按能力表回答，并建议使用已验证的连接器。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps you discover NotFair-supported ad platform connections, verify account access, and report whether the platform is read-only or mutable.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to connect an ad account, configure an ads MCP, check available tools, etc.

say_en.note: It will verify OAuth and list accessible accounts.

say_en.text: Check if Meta Ads MCP tools are available
say_en.note: It will inspect the current tool list and report availability.

say_en.text: Can NotFair modify my LinkedIn ads?
say_en.note: It will answer per the capability map and suggest a verified connector.
